title: Fake Airdrops and Dangerous Token Approvals
summary: Scam “airdrops” drop unfamiliar tokens into your wallet or advertise a claim site. Interacting can prompt you to approve a contract that then drains your assets.
blocks: Scam “airdrops” drop unfamiliar tokens into your wallet or advertise a claim site. Interacting can prompt you to approve a contract that then drains your assets.
The danger is the approval, not the token sitting there. Granting a malicious contract permission can let it move your funds later, even after you close the page.
Be cautious with unexpected tokens, avoid “claim” sites you did not seek out, and periodically review and revoke token approvals you no longer need.
